summary:
Implementation plan for Prayer Focus v2.2.23:
1. Use uploaded islamic.png (Sujud under crescent moon) everywhere as the official icon across Web app, Chrome extension toolbar, manifest, and icons directory.
2. Replace all non-working APIs in the 5-tier diagnostic engine with verified working providers: AlAdhan Coordinates, AlAdhan City (WaktuSolat), PrayZone API, Islamic Network API, and Local Astronomical Solar Engine. Completely eliminate SITP.
3. Add Direct Manual Time Entry (HH:mm) per prayer in Settings with individual waqt overrides, enabled toggle, and reset options.
4. Update Overview View's Daily Prayer Schedule cards to display start-to-end waqt time limits (e.g. 4:45 AM – 6:01 AM).
5. Harden GitHub Actions CI workflow to build, package, and release the extension cleanly.
